desc: Compute the `suff` array where `suff[x]` is the number of distinct integers in the suffix $A[x \dots N]$.
Precompute the `next_occ` array where `next_occ[i]` is the index of the first occurrence of $A[i]$ in $A[i+1 \dots N]$. If it doesn't exist, set it to $N$.
Implement a Segment Tree (or similar structure) that supports range addition and range maximum query.
Initialize the Segment Tree with values corresponding to $i = N-2$ (specifically, for $j=N-1$, value is $1 + \text{suff}[N]$).
Identify the range $[i+1, \text{next\_occ}[i]-1]$ where the distinct count increases by 1 when moving from $i+1$ to $i$.
Perform a range add operation on the Segment Tree for this interval.
Query the maximum value in the range $[i+1, N-1]$ from the Segment Tree. Let this be $P[i]$.
Calculate the total score for this split as $\text{pref}[i] + P[i]$ and update the global maximum.
Write the complete Python code to solve the problem, integrating all the above steps, and output the result to stdout.
Run the code against Sample Input 1 and Sample Input 2 to verify correctness.
